description: This PHP class `EmployeeEducationDecorator` provides a decorator pattern implementation for the `EmployeeEducation` entity within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to set related Employee and Education entities by their identifiers and to retrieve formatted start and end dates for employee education records.

classes.name: EmployeeEducationDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that adds additional functionality to the EmployeeEducation entity, including setting related entities and formatting date fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with an EmployeeEducation entity.

methods.name: getEmployeeEducation
methods.description: Protected method to retrieve the wrapped EmployeeEducation entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee entity associated with the education record based on an employee number.

methods.name: setEducationByEducationId
methods.description: Sets the Education entity associated with the education record based on an education ID.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted start date of the education record.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted end date of the education record.
